name: Violet
source: A young lady who recently joined the Bureau, she has begun rising through the ranks thanks to her confidence and attention to detail. A rare esper, she has the psychic ability to read the emotions of others. She clearly has refined sensibilities, but the Bureau's memory erasure has made the circumstances of her past unknown.
